verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because Convertio is a SaaS product with a developer API that could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. A direct probe of llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any candidate path. The pack contains no other evidence of agent-oriented documentation, only standard API, CLI and wrapper references.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
